Alex G: Quick sync — just got OpenFoundry's draft license. Major ask: dual-license (Apache-compatible + commercial redistribution addendum). Thoughts?

Maria R: Can you paste the clause? I want to check marketplace allowed redistribution rights.

Alex G: here's the relevant snippet:
```
Section 4.b: "No commercial redistribution without express written addendum and fee schedule. Derivative weights or converted binaries considered redistribution unless otherwise permitted."
```

Elaine (Legal): That language is pretty broad. They want a redistribution fee for marketplace bundles. Need exact wording — 'commercial redistribution' is vague. We should ask for a cap and clear examples of covered activities.

Jordan P: If fee applies to marketplace downloads it will change SKU revenue splits; need ETA on numbers. Also need asset format (wheel vs tar.gz vs OCI) and whether downloads vs hosted inference are both counted.

Sam T: RigelHW (hardware partner) needs models packaged as quantized ONNX + a small JSON manifest with headers. Any objections? The clause seems to restrict 'derivative weights' so conversions might be blocked.

Alex G: Good catch. Elaine, does 'derivative weights' cover quantized/converted builds? If so, need explicit permission for hardware partner conversions and per-SKU redistribution.

Elaine (Legal): Yes — we'll request explicit conversion permission and an SI/appliance carve-out. I'll draft an amendment asking for: explicit conversion/quantization rights, permission for SI integrations and appliance images, and a clarified royalty model. Also propose a time-limited royalty waiver for launch (e.g., 30 days).

Maria R: For joint announcement, they requested a 72-hour embargo. Marketplace needs 7-day pre-announce assets for PR review. Can we counter with a 48-hour mutual embargo + 5-day marketplace prep window?

Jordan P: 5-day prep is doable if we get final model artifacts + marketing copy in 3 days. Also need canonical model card, token budget reference, and perf numbers (latency/throughput) for our listing.

Alex G: I'll ask for the model card + perf numbers. Sam — can Rigel ship quantized artifacts within 3 days of final sign-off?

Sam T: Probably yes if they provide float checkpoints. We'll need: model shape, tokenizer files, seq-len tests, and a small validation set. Estimate 48h conversion effort once we have floats.

marketplace-bot: Checklist created: /checklists/openfoundry-launch-2691234567 

Alex G: Action items: Elaine to send amendment; Jordan to model SKU/rev impact; Sam to confirm packaging requirements; Maria to draft announcement timeline. Meeting Thursday 11am PT to close outstanding items. :calendar: :thumbsup:

Elaine (Legal): Amendment draft goes out EOD today. Will propose: explicit conversion rights, SI/appliance carve-out, 30-day launch royalty waiver, and mutual embargo of 48 hours. I'll include sample language and a redline.

Maria R: I'll assemble the PR checklist and send to Alex + Jordan. Need final logo assets and a one-paragraph partner quote from OpenFoundry — I'll request it in my message.

Alex G: Thanks all. I'll message OpenFoundry with the asks and a deadline (COB Tue).
